title: Keeping the bench clean
caption: One cleanup per mess, and sometimes the cleanest fix is a clean bench.
framing: An illustrative one-to-one pairing from IBM Technology's video

validate.after: The sheet checked against a real bike

the-videos-framing.description: IBM Technology presents validate, compact, curate and prune as one fix for each of four failure modes. This is a teaching framework, not an exhaustive or exclusive mapping; real problems can overlap and one fix can help with more than one mode [1].

ibm-context-engineering-failure-modes.title: IBM Technology, Context Engineering for AI Agents: 4 Failure Modes to Avoid

breunig-lists-other-fixes.description: his companion post names six: RAG, tool loadout, context quarantine, pruning, summarization and offloading. Picking fewer than 30 tools improved selection accuracy up to threefold [1].

breunig-how-to-fix-your-context.title: Drew Breunig, How to Fix Your Context

one-fix-per-mode-is-a-simplification.header: One fix per mode is a simplification
one-fix-per-mode-is-a-simplification.description: failure modes and fixes can overlap: compaction may preserve a bad fact in a clean summary, so it does not necessarily repair poisoning. The connection between a fresh window and both compact and prune is an inference. Anthropic also warns that overly aggressive compaction can lose subtle but critical context [1].

anthropic-effective-context-engineering.title: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents

four-cleanups.title: Four cleanups
four-cleanups.script: IBM's video pairs four cleanups with four kinds of mess as a teaching framework: validate by checking the sheet against a real bike; compact by replacing a binder with a summary; curate by keeping only the tools a job needs; prune by removing old instructions. The pairs are not exclusive—real problems can overlap, and a fix may help in more than one case.

fresh-chat.title: Fresh chat
fresh-chat.script: Sometimes the cleanest fix is a clean bench. Start a fresh chat and bring only the result, not the whole history. That is the second actionable, and I come back to it in the last Section.
